say:1:1430102101:1.text: No way! There should still be... Wait! How come there's only one turkey leg left?!
say:1:1430102101:1.source_cn: 我没有！盘子里明明还有……怎么就剩一根鸡腿了？

say:2:1430102102:1.text: I only took a few bites... Oh, the chief is going to switch my backside for this!
say:2:1430102102:1.source_cn: 我明明只吃了几口而已……完了，这次村长一定会狠狠踢我的屁股！

say:3:1430102103:1.text: If I'm going to get yelled at anyway, then this last turkey leg is mine!
say:3:1430102103:1.source_cn: 等等，既然肯定会挨训，那我为什么还要留着这根鸡腿呢？
